No theme is scorable with a proxy ETF except China Tech/Internet and Platform Megacaps (both ineligible, rank 13/15), so accountability is sharply constrained — I will lean mostly on trend-gate eligibility and narrative structure, not rank.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks are the only rank leader that is simultaneously trend-gate eligible, with the highest durability bar (0.59) among eligible names and breadth 0.538 — the one narrative where leadership, the trend gate, and participation overlap.
